Report mandates (12 report mandates)

Statutory duties that require this agency to publish or file a report, with a City Record filing receipt when that report appears.

  • ◆Mandate · Submit to the council and post on its website quarterly reports regarding the three-quarters house task force, including specified violation, bed, rent-payment, and relocation information.
    report · deadline 2017-03-17 · quarterly · Section 1.b · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Post on its website and submit to the speaker of the council an aggregate report on arrests, summonses, removals, escorts and use of force incidents in job centers and SNAP centers for the preceding quarter; the report must not contain personally identifiable information and must include the information specified in § 21-142.1(b)(1)-(6).
    report · deadline 2019-10-14 · quarterly · Administrative Code § 21-142.1(b) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Post and submit subsequent reports on reopened cases after each quarter.
    report · deadline 2019-10-29 · quarterly · Administrative Code § 21-142(d) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Post on its website and submit to the speaker of the council an aggregate report on arrests, summonses, removals, escorts and use of force incidents in job centers and SNAP centers for the preceding quarter; the report must not contain personally identifiable information and must include the information specified in § 21-142.1(b)(1)-(6).
    report · deadline 2020-01-31 · annual · Administrative Code § 21-142.1(b) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit the feasibility-study report to the mayor and speaker of the council and post it on the Department of Social Services website.
    report · deadline 2024-04-18 · one-time · § 1(b) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · The commissioner must provide written semiannual reports to the Council regarding referrals to adult protective services, including specified referral, ineligibility, source, and geographic information, while not sharing identifying information about referred individuals or referral sources.
    report · deadline: Each report shall be submitted within sixty days of the end of such period. · ongoing · Administrative Code § 21-136(b) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Post on the department’s website and submit to the speaker of the council annual reports containing information on supportive housing in CAPS for the preceding fiscal year, including the information specified in paragraphs 1 through 8.
    report · deadline: Not later than September 1, 2022 · annual · § 21-148(b)(1)-(8) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Post on its website and submit to the speaker of the council and the public advocate a report on reopened cases for the relevant reporting period, including the specified information and disaggregations.
    report · one-time · Administrative Code § 21-142(d) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit a report on the findings of each baseline survey to the mayor and speaker of the council and post each report on the Department of Social Services website.
    report · one-time · § 1(c)(2) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Issue a progress report on the pilot program, submit it to the mayor and speaker of the council, and post it on the Department of Social Services website.
    report · deadline: not later than 2 years after the commencement of the guaranteed income pilot program · one-time · § 1(e) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit a final report on the pilot program to the mayor and speaker of the council and post it on the Department of Social Services website.
    report · deadline: not later than 1 year after the conclusion of the guaranteed income pilot program · one-time · § 1(f) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit written quarterly reports to the mayor and council containing the specified service-request, processing-time, staffing, case, housing, facility, hearing, and inspection data.
    report · deadline: no later than 60 days after the last day of the time period covered by the report · quarterly · Administrative Code § 21-128(j) · Source law↗

Rulemaking mandates (4 rulemaking mandates)

Statutory duties that require this agency to make rules, shown with City Record Agency Rules filings from the Rules lens.

Rulemaking mandates

  • ◆Mandate · Take measures necessary for implementation of the local law, including promulgation of rules, before the law’s effective date.
    rulemaking · deadline 2023-07-13 · one-time · Int. No. 229, § 2 · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Publish a proposed rule establishing a bill of rights for persons with HIV infection.
    rulemaking · deadline: No later than 60 days from the effective date of the local law that added this section · one-time · Administrative Code § 21-128(h) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Hold at least one noticed public hearing on the proposed bill of rights before publishing the final rule.
    rulemaking · deadline: Within 60 days following the publication of such proposed rule, and prior to the publication of a final rule · one-time · Administrative Code § 21-128(h) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Publish the final bill-of-rights rule, review and revise it annually where appropriate, post it conspicuously in public division offices, and make it available in English, Spanish, and other appropriate languages.
    rulemaking · deadline: within 30 days after the conclusion of such hearing; thereafter on an annual basis · annual · Administrative Code § 21-128(h) · Source law↗

Sources and measure definitions

  • IBO New York City Fiscal History: actual department expenditures in publisher $000s, shown here in USD; staffing is actual full-time positions reported as of June 30. Publisher vintage FY2022.
  • PASSPort Public procurement records: registered contract values and counts are a point-in-time snapshot of current registered value, not actual spending.
  • Checkbook NYC, the Comptroller's spending ledger: actual payment amounts and transaction counts, not registered contract values.

These sources use different accounting scopes.
